invoice.definition: The document that records a sale. It takes its number when issued, with no gap in the series, and is never changed afterwards: a credit note corrects it.

credit_note.definition: The document that cancels or reduces all or part of an issued invoice, without ever changing it.

quote.definition: A priced offer made to the customer; once accepted, it can become an invoice.

delivery_note.definition: It goes with the goods handed to the customer; once validated, it takes them out of stock.

stamp_duty.definition: A fixed duty that the Tunisian finance law adds to every invoice.

withholding.definition: The part of a payment the customer keeps and pays to the State itself on behalf of its supplier, who deducts it from its own tax.

vat_franchise.definition: A small French business that does not charge VAT, below turnover thresholds; its invoices say so.

reverse_charge.definition: The customer declares and pays the VAT; the invoice says so.

accounting_export.title: Accounting export
accounting_export.intro: The files your accountant takes into their software for a period: sales, purchases, payments received and VAT. Only issued documents and expenses entered in the books are in them; a credit note is negative.
accounting_export.period_invalid: Choose two days in order, a year apart at most.

purchases-journal.name: Purchases journal

payments-journal.does: Each payment received on an invoice during the period.

vat-summary.does: The bases and taxes of sales and purchases, by tax and rate. It does not say what is due.

recurring.title: Recurring invoices
recurring.intro: An invoice that comes back at a regular interval: every week, every two months, the last Friday every three months, every year on 31 October. On each due day a copy is prepared as a draft for a person to check and issue: nothing goes out by itself. Make one from an invoice, with « Make recurring ».

make.intro: Each due day prepares a draft copied from this invoice, dated that day. Nothing is issued without you.

recurring.made: The invoice is recurring: its first draft will be prepared on the day chosen.
recurring.resumed: Recurring invoice for {{customer}} resumed: the due days passed during the pause are skipped.

errors.invalid: The recurring invoice could not be saved.
errors.not_found: This recurring invoice no longer exists.
errors.network: The server is not answering. Try again in a moment.
errors.modelInvoiceId: A credit note, a deposit invoice or an abandoned invoice is not made recurring.
errors.startsOn: The first draft is made today or later, never on a day already past.
errors.endsOn: The last day comes on the day of the first draft or after it.

notification_stop.title: Stop receiving this e-mail
notification_stop.intro: This link stops one kind of notification from being e-mailed to you, in one company only. The app’s bell still counts it.
notification_stop.done: Done: this kind of notification will no longer be e-mailed to you. You can turn it back on in My account › Notifications.

errors.link_not_usable: This link can no longer be used: this kind of notification is no longer told to you there. Choose your e-mails in My account › Notifications.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.network: The server is not answering. Try again.

stock_map.short: {{floors}} {floors, plural, one {floor} other {floors}}, {{places}} {places, plural, one {rectangle} other {rectangles}}, {{structures}} {structures, plural, one {element} other {elements}}

drafts.title: Drafts and quotes
drafts.count: {{drafts}} {drafts, plural, one {draft} other {drafts}}, {{quotes}} {quotes, plural, one {quote} other {quotes}}
drafts.short: {{drafts}} {drafts, plural, one {draft} other {drafts}}, {{quotes}} {quotes, plural, one {quote} other {quotes}}
drafts.effect: Nothing issued: erased entirely. A draft a recurring invoice copies, and a quote an issued invoice names, stay.

products.title: Products and prices
products.effect: Those on an issued document are archived, not erased: the document keeps its line.

customers.title: Customers
customers.effect: Same rule: an invoiced customer is archived; the others are erased.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.effect: A vendor linked to a recorded expense is archived.

stock_reset.title: Stock reset to zero
stock_reset.effect: A count to zero per line: each quantity goes back to zero, the movement history stays whole.

files.title: Files and photos
files.effect: Product photos and imported files; the PDFs of issued documents stay.

settings.title: Settings back to defaults
settings.effect: The profile, numbering and taxes do not move.

support_access.title: Support access
support_access.intro: Open {{company}} to the platform’s support when you ask it for help: it then sees your screens as you do, without being able to change anything.
support_access.reads: It reads everything the company holds, read-only.
support_access.never: It exports nothing, prints no selection of documents and does not see cost prices.
support_access.logged: Its arrival and every page it reads are written in the
support_access.owner_only: Only the company’s owner opens support access.
support_access.open_until: Support may read the company until {{until}}.
support_access.closed: Support has no access to the company.

refused.network: The request did not go through. Try again.
refused.not_found: This company can no longer be reached.
refused.owner_only: Only the owner opens support access.
refused.support_window: Choose one of the lengths offered.
refused.support_reason: What is wrong is too long for support: shorten it.
refused.step_up_required: Nothing changed: confirm it is you to make this change.

support_access.read_only: Support reads the company read-only: nothing is changed or exported.
support_access.banner_support: You are reading {{company}} for support, read-only, until {{until}}.
support_access.banner_members: The platform’s support may read the company until {{until}}.
support_access.reason_hint: What support should look at, for instance “the 3 March invoice prints without the stamp”. They read it on opening the company.
support_access.closed_by_owner: The owner of {{company}} closed support access. Back to the platform.
